say:4:1760009002:1.text: Sorry, Gabumon! It took me too long to get here.
say:4:1760009002:1.source_cn: 抱歉，加布兽，让你久等了。

say:5:1760009003:0.text: Thank you, Gabumon... For everything you've done for me.
say:5:1760009003:0.source_cn: 谢谢你为我做了这么多……谢谢你，加布兽。

say:6:1760009004:0.text: If it means seeing you again, Yamato, I'd do anything.
say:6:1760009004:0.source_cn: 没关系，只要能和大和再次见面，我什么都愿意做。

say:7:1760009005:1.text: But... I broke a lot of school rules, so I might be stuck in detention for quite a while...
say:7:1760009005:1.source_cn: 只是……大和，我违反了很多校规，可能要被关很久禁闭……

say:9:1760009007:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you take us to see Contess again?
say:9:1760009007:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you take us to see Contess again?
say:9:1760009007:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you take us to see Contess again?

narration:12:1760009008:1.text: You help the group evade the guards and lead them back to the library...
narration:12:1760009008:1.male: You help the group evade the guards and lead them back to the library...
narration:12:1760009008:1.female: You help the group evade the guards and lead them back to the library...

say:17:1760009010:0.text: Contess, is it possible that I take Gabumon's punishment in his place?
say:17:1760009010:0.source_cn: 我有一事相求。我想申请，能不能把加布兽的惩罚，换到我身上？

say:20:1760009012:1.text: Are you sure? Gabumon has broken more school rules than just one or two. Do you even know how lengthy and scary the punishments will be?
say:20:1760009012:1.source_cn: 哦？加布兽违反了很多校规，要承受的惩罚可是很多、很复杂...

say:21:1760009013:1.text: First... you'll be locked in a dark detention room, where the only sound you'll hear is your own heartbeat.
say:21:1760009013:1.source_cn: 比如……被关在黑暗的、安静的禁闭室里。

say:22:1760009014:1.text: Then, you'll be made to clean every trophy and picture frame on campus until they're spotless.
say:22:1760009014:1.source_cn: 或者是把莱希拉姆所有陈列的奖杯和画框都擦一遍，一点灰尘...

say:23:1760009015:1.text: Next, you'll be assigned to grow poisonous magic plants in the greenhouse...
say:23:1760009015:1.source_cn: 又比如，在温室做苦工，培育带毒性的魔法植物……

choice_prompt:24:1760009015.text: Next, you'll be assigned to grow poisonous magic plants in the greenhouse...
choice_prompt:24:1760009015.source_cn: 又比如，在温室做苦工，培育带毒性的魔法植物……

say:31:1760009020:1.text: Hey, we're friends! I'll stay by your side, even when things get tough.
say:31:1760009020:1.source_cn: 我说过，我们是同伴。同伴彼此之间，就是要一起分担困难啊。

say:32:1760009021:1.text: Let's get this done and over with, then we'll go home together!
say:32:1760009021:1.source_cn: 我们尽快接受完惩罚，然后一起回去吧！

say:37:1760009023:1.text: My, my... Young people are always so sentimental about friendship. I can't stand it...
say:37:1760009023:1.source_cn: 哎呀哎呀……年轻人总是这么容易因为友情而热血，真是受不了……

say:38:1760009024:1.text: Well, since the blueprint is back in the library, and Solise isn't making a fuss over her plants, I'm letting you off this time.
say:38:1760009024:1.source_cn: 算啦，反正图纸也还回来了，娑丽丝也表示不追究魔法植物的...

say:40:1760009026:0.text: *Yawn*... Now, off you go. I need to get back to sleep.
say:40:1760009026:0.source_cn: 我才懒得骗你们呢。呵欠……快走吧，我要回去补觉了……

choice_prompt:43:1760009026.text: *Yawn*... Now, off you go. I need to get back to sleep.
choice_prompt:43:1760009026.source_cn: 我才懒得骗你们呢。呵欠……快走吧，我要回去补觉了……

say:45:1760009028:0.text: Stargazing, divination, and seeing the future... Aren't those your specialties, my dear Merlin?
say:45:1760009028:0.source_cn: 观星、占卜、预测……这不是小梅林你擅长的事情吗？
say:45:1760009028:0.male: Stargazing, divination, and seeing the future... Aren't those your specialties, my dear Merlin?
say:45:1760009028:0.female: Stargazing, divination, and seeing the future... Aren't those your specialties, my dear Merlin?

narration:47:1760009029:0.text: Contess' words spark a thought. You could head to the Stellar Spire's observatory and seek inspiration from the stars...
narration:47:1760009029:0.source_cn: 康缇丝的话语提醒了你。在群星之塔的观星台上，群星或许能...

narration:47:1760009029:0.female: Contess' words spark a thought. You could head to the Stellar Spire's observatory and seek inspiration from the stars...

say:48:1760009030:0.text: Cranky guides you to the top of the Stellar Spire. Overhead, the night sky unfurls like a vast black canvas, adorned with countless shining stars.
say:48:1760009030:0.source_cn: 在塔塔的指引下，你们一路登至塔顶。暗色铺陈的夜空，无边...
say:48:1760009030:0.male: Cranky guides you to the top of the Stellar Spire. Overhead, the night sky unfurls like a vast black canvas, adorned with countless shining stars.
say:48:1760009030:0.female: Cranky guides you to the top of the Stellar Spire. Overhead, the night sky unfurls like a vast black canvas, adorned with countless shining stars.

say:50:1760009031:1.text: You gaze deeper into the night sky, discerning the patterns of the stars and the secrets they conceal.
say:50:1760009031:1.source_cn: 向夜空的更远处看去。你辨识出更多的星星，看清它们排布的...
say:50:1760009031:1.male: You gaze deeper into the night sky, discerning the patterns of the stars and the secrets they conceal.
say:50:1760009031:1.female: You gaze deeper into the night sky, discerning the patterns of the stars and the secrets they conceal.

say:51:1760009032:1.text: Then, a star rises, hanging far higher than it should. It points toward... the Lionheart Hunting Grounds in Savannah.
say:51:1760009032:1.source_cn: 你看到一颗星星升起，挂在它本不该在的高位。那个方向是…...
say:51:1760009032:1.male: Then, a star rises, hanging far higher than it should. It points toward... the Lionheart Hunting Grounds in Savannah.
say:51:1760009032:1.female: Then, a star rises, hanging far higher than it should. It points toward... the Lionheart Hunting Grounds in Savannah.

say:52:1760009033:1.text: Elsewhere, a cluster of stars appears closer than usual, their glow thinning the darkness around them.
say:52:1760009033:1.source_cn: 另一群星星，则比平时离得更近，连那一片夜色都被星光映得...

say:53:1760009034:1.text: The stars have revealed the answer: a Hypofiend will soon emerge in the Lionheart Hunting Grounds, powerful enough to trigger a dimensional distortion.
say:53:1760009034:1.source_cn: 群星无声地将答案告知于你：狮心猎场即将出现一只强大的魔...
say:53:1760009034:1.male: The stars have revealed the answer: a Hypofiend will soon emerge in the Lionheart Hunting Grounds, powerful enough to trigger a dimensional distortion.
say:53:1760009034:1.female: The stars have revealed the answer: a Hypofiend will soon emerge in the Lionheart Hunting Grounds, powerful enough to trigger a dimensional distortion.

say:54:1760009035:1.text: The boundary between the two worlds will soon reach its weakest point in recent times. With enough energy, a dimensional rift can be torn open again.
say:54:1760009035:1.source_cn: 同时，世界的边界即将进入近期最薄弱的时间点。只要释放出...

say:55:1760009036:1.text: This could very well open the path back to the Digital World.
say:55:1760009036:1.source_cn: 这或许就是让孩子们和数码宝贝，回归数码世界的方法。

choice:43:0:1.text: Wait! Any chance you know something about dimensional rifts?
choice:43:0:1.source_cn: 等一下！你了解次元裂隙吗？
choice:43:0:1.male: Wait! Any chance you know something about dimensional rifts?
choice:43:0:1.female: Wait! Any chance you know something about dimensional rifts?

choice:43:1:2.text: Do you know how they can return to their world?
choice:43:1:2.source_cn: 你知道怎么送他们回到数码世界吗？
choice:43:1:2.male: Do you know how they can return to their world?
choice:43:1:2.female: Do you know how they can return to their world?

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 这些惩罚也太严苛了吧！
